label: Hosting provider
description: Can remove or disable hosted content or infrastructure it controls.

label: DNS provider
description: Can stop serving authoritative DNS or change resolution for zones it operates.

label: Registrar
description: Maintains the registrant relationship and submits registration changes to the registry.

label: Registry operator
description: Maintains the TLD registry and can add, modify or delete registrations through the registry system under applicable rules.

label: Browser / security layer
description: Can warn, block or distrust destinations independently of the domain registration itself.

label: ICANN
description: Coordinates policies and contracts for gTLDs but is not a general-purpose content regulator or Internet police force.
